answer_1.quote: We introduce the CalcQA benchmark, a new benchmark to assess the capabilities of LLMs in clinical calculator scenarios, including 100 calculator pairs based on real patients' cases, along with 281 medical calculator tools.
answer_1.outputs: Calculator selection, slot filling, unit conversion, and final calculation results in medical scenarios

answer_2.quote: We employ four novel metrics, designed to quantify the accuracy of agents in selecting appropriate calculators, the agents' ability to fill tool slots, their competence for nested tool calling, and the overall performance of MeNTi in executing end-to-end tasks.

answer_4.quote: We hired experienced physicians to select the appropriate calculators for each case and to thoroughly document the rationale for their choices, their diagnostic opinions, and calculator assessment results.
answer_4.guideline: Physicians selected calculators based on real patient cases and provided diagnostic pathways; annotations were reviewed for accuracy and consistency.
